full_name: Elizabeth A. Herbin-Triant | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 History Radcliffe Institute Fellow Amherst College
bio: Elizabeth A. Herbin-Triant combines African American history and the history of capitalism (particularly racial capitalism) to study the long history of white supremacy and African American opposition to white supremacy.
